description: Fast, lightweight text editor built in Rust with its own rendering engine

suggest.extras/vcredist2022: Winc links against VCRUNTIME140.dll; install the Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable if it is missing

notes: Windows x64 only; Windows 10 1809 or later is required.
The portable build does not self-update: settings, recent folders and backups of unsaved changes live in persist\winc\data, so 'scoop update winc' keeps them.
Upstream signs the NSIS/MSI installers, but winc.exe in the portable ZIP is unsigned; a SmartScreen prompt on first launch is possible.
On Windows, Winc can open folders inside WSL distributions.
